entities.name: Jonas Žemaitis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jonas Žemaitis, also known under his nom de guerre Vytautas, was a Lithuanian general and freedom fighter who served as the president of Lithuania from 1949 until his death in 1954. A Lithuanian partisan, armed resister of Soviet occupation, and the chairman of the Union of Lithuanian Freedom Fighters, Žemaitis was posthumously nominated and acknowledged as the head of state of Lithuania following the re-establishment of independence.

entities.summary: Jonas Žemaitis, also known under his nom de guerre Vytautas, was a Lithuanian general and freedom fighter who served as the president of Lithuania from 1949 until his death in 1954. A Lithuanian partisan, armed resister of Soviet occupation, and the chairman of the Union of Lithuanian Freedom Fighters, Žemaitis was posthumously nominated and acknowledged as the head of state of Lithuania following the re-establishment of independence.
